records.mutant: delete field kind from struct BackendError expression in check
records.reason: INVALID_INPUT is 0 in backend.proto, the proto3 default, so deleting the field leaves the same value.
records.evidence: check builds BackendError with ..BackendError::default(), and the default kind is the enum's zero, INVALID_INPUT. A proto3 scalar at its default is not encoded, so the bytes with the field and without it are equal, and no test can tell the two apart.
